wowsims-spelldata.goBinary.description: The go binary that starts the hover server. `go` searches the PATH, then GOROOT and the usual install directories; set a full path if none of them has it. A full path that does not exist falls back to the same search.

wowsims-spelldata.trace.description: Log how each hover was resolved to the WoWSims Spelldata output channel.
